assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq2000), mouse C57BL/6 male; each library = pooled RNA from 4 animals (S4.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of a swimming exercise program (ramp 10->90 min twice daily, then 2 weeks) on the inguinal WAT (iWAT) transcriptome versus room-temperature control iWAT (S2.1.p1, S4.4.p1)
sample_inclusion: iWAT series S2: control (S2CNT_1/2) and swimming (S2SWIM_1/2); CL316243 and 7-day cold iWAT share the same control and are the paper's other browning arms. BAT series (S3, S5) are separate experiments (BAT whitening at 30C, BAT cold activation) with their own controls and are not part of the exercise estimand.
planned_contrasts: iWAT swimming vs iWAT control (S2.2.p1; paper: 673 up + 826 down mRNAs)
iWAT 4C 7d cold vs control (S2.2.p1; paper: 1062 up + 1201 down) - other browning arm, exploratory here
iWAT CL316243 vs control (S2.2.p1; paper: 837 up + 681 down) - other browning arm, exploratory here
repeated_measure_unit: none; each library is a pool of 4 independent mice (S4.2.p1); 2 pools per condition
paper_results: Exercise iWAT: 673 up / 826 down mRNAs; induction of Ucp1, Elovl3, Cidea and mitochondrial genes across browning conditions (S2.2.p1, S1E Fig); GSEA GOBP up: cellular respiration, BAT gene set; down: immune processes, WAT gene set (S1F Fig)
